typography.notes: User requested Inter. Used Inter for body to meet requirement but paired with IBM Plex Sans for headings to maintain E1's anti-default rule and achieve a highly professional, SAP Fiori / ServiceNow enterprise aesthetic.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Minimal Glassmorphism. Use solid white backgrounds for cards, with soft shadows. Glassmorphism only for sticky top nav (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80).

layouts.structure: Left sidebar (260px wide, collapsible) + Top Nav (64px high) + Main Content Area.
layouts.sidebar: Dark or light variant. If dark, use #0F172A with #FFFFFF text. If light, use #F8FAFC with #0F172A text. Includes: Dashboard, Student Portal, Security Operations, Inventory Management, Reports, Notifications, Administration, Settings.
layouts.top_nav: Contains Search input (Shadcn), Notifications (bell icon), Profile Dropdown, Dark Mode Toggle, and Breadcrumb.
layouts.content_spacing: Generous padding. Use p-6 or p-8 for main content containers.
layouts.grid_system: High Density Grid (Bento Mode B) for Executive KPI Dashboard. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Prioritize top-left for main KPIs.

components.buttons: Shadcn buttons. Primary blue, secondary outline (slate-200 border, slate-700 text).
components.tables: Professional Data Tables (Shadcn). Must include pagination, filtering, column sorting. Zebra striping or solid white with bottom borders.
components.charts: Recharts wrapped in Shadcn chart components. Line, Pie, Donut, Area, Bar, Heat Map. Clean tooltips, subtle grid lines.
components.forms: Professional Forms (Shadcn). Left-aligned labels, clear placeholder text, structured in multi-column layouts where applicable.
components.cards: Dashboard Cards. White background, soft shadow, rounded-xl, 1px border. Progressive disclosure: summary on card, detail via click/modal.

specialized.warehouse_inventory: Grid-based visualization of racks/bins using inventory_bins color coding.
specialized.bpmn_diagram: Use customized Flow nodes (React Flow) to represent As-Is vs To-Be processes.
specialized.kpi_cards: Include metric, label, and trend indicator (e.g., +2.4% with green arrow).

motion.hover: Subtle translate-y-[-2px] on interactive cards. Color transitions (duration-200) on buttons.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders (Shadcn) for data-heavy sections instead of spinners.
motion.page_transitions: Framer Motion fade-in (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0) for dashboard widgets (staggered).

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA/WCAG AA minimums. No light gray text on white background.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 focus:outline-none on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-inventory').

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (duotone for sidebar/empty states, regular for dense UI) OR lucide-react. Keep stroke widths consistent.
media.illustrations: NO playful illustrations. Use abstract geometric patterns or high-quality professional photography if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly generate .js and .jsx files. DO NOT USE TypeScript (.tsx).
Use standard Tailwind CSS classes. Adhere to the defined color palette (Primary Blue #0052CC).
Emulate SAP Fiori / ServiceNow enterprise aesthetics. Avoid consumer-facing app looks.
Build the UI heavily relying on Shadcn UI primitives (Tables, Dialogs, Selects, Cards, Forms).
Use Recharts for all analytical widgets (Line, Pie, Donut, Area, Bar). Build a Heat Map for warehouse density.
Create 4 distinct role-based views in the frontend routing/layout structure.
Implement the Student Parcel Portal with OTP/QR visual placeholders.
Implement the Security Operations workflow for receiving parcels.
The warehouse inventory screen MUST visualize physical racks and bins with the 4-color status codes.
For the BPMN process diagram, utilize React Flow if possible, or build an SVG/HTML-based flowchart.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals. Always use solid white.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and major layout containers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined subtle shadows and precise typography to create a premium feel.
Never center-align paragraphs or data tables.
Do not use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
Ensure generous padding inside cards (p-6) so content does not collide with borders.
